Unfold tailors devotionals and reading journeys based on your selected focus areas, goals, and reading pace.

Can beginners use this Bible study plan?

Yes. Unfold is designed for beginners and experienced readers with approachable daily sessions.

Does Unfold support personalized Bible study recommendations?

Yes. Unfold is built around personalized devotional journeys so your daily study aligns with your spiritual season and goals.

Where can I download the Unfold app?

You can download Unfold on iOS from the App Store.
